description: Atomic stock reservation and overselling prevention under concurrent offer acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Database row-locking with select_for_update; reserved_qtl <= quantity_qtl; cannot oversell available stock.

description: Delivery acceptance, partial fulfillment, and listing inventory reduction
acceptance_criteria: Only buyer can confirm receipt; accepted stock atomically subtracted from reserved and total listing inventory.
evidence: Tested in test_trade_resolution.py.

description: Two-party order change requests (remainder cancellation and return) and dispute management
acceptance_criteria: Remainder cancellation requires counterparty approval and releases reserved inventory; dispute freezes order state.
evidence: Tested in test_trade_resolution.py.

description: Transporter onboarding, vehicle registration, admin verification, and capacity constraints
acceptance_criteria: Transporters register vehicles; admin verifies vehicle with review evidence; unverified vehicles cannot quote.
evidence: Tested in test_freight_milestones.py and test_trade_resolution.py.

description: Freight requests, competitive quoting, carrier assignment, and conflict prevention
acceptance_criteria: Farmer creates freight request; verified transporter quotes; assignment prevents vehicle double-booking on same date.
